label: [POST-ROUTE SYNTHESIS ESTIMATE]

hardened.critical_path: s counter -> address look-ahead -> image distributed-RAM -> stream register (11 logic levels)

baseline_before_hardening.critical_path: s counter -> per-PE control decode (routing-dominated, 74.8% route)

frozen_array_v2_only.note: OOC systolic_array_v2 alone (Decision 12); the controller consumes the margin

changes.register_control: accum_clear / weight_load registered at array boundary (look-ahead)
changes.pipeline_counters: per-cycle MAC increments registered; 32-bit accumulators add a cycle later
changes.result_base_shifts: ch*784 / y*28 expanded as shifts (removed 3 controller DSPs)
changes.max_fanout: max_fanout=16 on s counter and mode_active_r
changes.cost: +69 FF (pipeline registers); -3 DSP, -1873 LUT (removed controller DSP arithmetic + net effect)

notes: WNS improved +0.030 -> +0.189 ns (6.3x margin); approx max freq 201 -> 208 MHz.
Residual critical path is the registered stream read (address look-ahead -> image dist-RAM); full 2-deep address pipelining is the remaining lever, documented in PHASE2_HARDENING.md.
DSP48E2 = 64 = 64 PE MACs (1/PE); the 3 controller address-arithmetic DSPs are eliminated.
BREG=0 for all PE MACs (mode-muxed weight path prevents DSP BREG inference; weight registered in fabric). Functional, bit-exact; documented (Decision 12 class).
